descriptionChirho: A castrated male, especially one serving in a royal household or harem, as in the court of Persian, Babylonian, or Israelite kings (e.g., the eunuchs of Esther's court, those who threw Jezebel down, Isaiah 56:3-4).

A high-ranking royal functionary or court officer, not necessarily castrated, used as a title of office rather than a description of physical condition (e.g., Potiphar as officer of Pharaoh, officers of the king).
